proposal_checks.note: PCB/body-outline checks exclude headers, plugs, cables, mass, frame strength, dynamic stability and actual mounting. Idealized water assumes a straight cylinder with 60 mm INTERNAL diameter, though supplied 60 mm is external/approximate, so no physical fill line is established. Illustrative masses 275 g base and 200 g bank are not measurements. V5 adds a purely geometric 70 x 50 bay with a 35 mm clear-height target; port locations, actual mated plug/strain-relief envelopes and cable bend compliance remain unverified. The bay overlaps the bank vertically only at the mating port plane; full 3D controller/header/plug fit is not checked. V6 reserves a separate 30 W x 55 D x 30 H target Uno-end pocket and shows one USB-A-to-USB-B cable, but exact socket pose, real cable envelope, rear switch reach and complete outer-case fit are not checked.
